主要内容: On June 2, 2017, Richard G. Rawson, President of Insperity, Inc., established new structured, prearranged trading plans to sell a portion of his beneficially owned shares of Insperity common stock over a period ending in August 2017, in accordance with Rule 10b5-1 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. Under the new plans, Mr. Rawson may sell a maximum of 51,000 shares, representing approximately 9% of his current common stock holdings. The plans were initiated during the company's open window for insider transactions. Rule 10b5-1 permits insiders to implement written plans for selling stock at times when they are not in possession of material nonpublic information, allowing them to sell stock on a regular and non-discretionary basis.
